title: Patch: the AI prices Burn and Toxic counters on units and heroes
thread:
**Issue #3822 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3822: Patch: the AI prices Burn and Toxic counters on units and heroes
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The newest set added Burn and Toxic: counters that hurt a unit or a hero at the start of its turn, Burn fading by 3 a tick and Toxic forever. The practice AI counts none of it. To the AI, a hero carrying Toxic 3 is as healthy as one without, and a unit about to burn to death is worth its full stats. Once this is built, the AI sees that damage coming: it doesn't spend an attack on a unit that will die by itself, it races harder when its own hero is on a Toxic clock, and it values putting Burn on the opponent's board.

## Why

- `crates/engine/src/afflictions.rs:47-62` exposes `burn_on`, `toxic_on`, `hero_burn_of` and `hero_toxic_of`, and nothing in `crates/ai/src` calls them. Grepping `burn|toxic` there finds only the feature layout's list of uncounted keywords (`features.rs:77-87`).
- The hand eval already prices Plague counters (`evaluate.rs:479-480`, `w.plague_counter`). The hero term is `hero_value(effective_life(..))` plus armor (`evaluate.rs:778-781`), with no affliction.
- SPEC §6, the Burn and Toxic rows, and R3540001: Burn ticks 8, 5, 2 and is gone; Toxic never drops and pierces Armor. Both are public (R3540005), so pricing them reads nothing hidden.
- The learned correction only re-scores finalists, and its layout leaves both out until a refit (`features.rs:77`). The beam prunes on the hand eval (`crates/ai/README.md`, "The learned evaluation"), and the reply sim sees at most one tick a side.
- About 29 card scripts deal Burn or Toxic (grep). Players already bring them against the AI (R3535000), and fullsend 2 (#3574) measures the AI on the set with a sweep whose bans are capped, so an AI blind to the set's damage over time costs bans there.

## Proposal

Add named weights to `EvalWeights`: set in `AI_EVAL`, and 0 in `GREEDY_EVAL` as the newer terms are, so the greedy baseline is unchanged.

- A unit's worth falls by its coming ticks, met by Divine Shield and Armor as R3540001 says. A unit the next tick kills is worth only what it can still do before then.
- A hero's side loses its coming ticks over a named horizon: Toxic every turn of it, and Burn's decaying series.

Every number goes in `crates/ai/src/config.rs` (CLAUDE.md rule 9). The AI README's evaluation section names the new terms.

## Where it lands

`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, `crates/ai/tests/ai/evaluate.rs` and `decide.rs`, `crates/ai/README.md`; SPEC §6 (Burn, Toxic) and §9.9 are read, not changed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Evaluate tests: Burn or Toxic on an enemy unit raises the seat's eval and on its own unit lowers it; a unit its next tick kills is worth less than the same unit without the counter; a hero's Toxic weighs more than an equal Burn over the horizon.
- [ ] A decide test: one attacker, two equal enemy targets, one of which its own Burn kills next turn; the AI attacks the other.
- [ ] `GREEDY_EVAL`'s new weights are 0, and the greedy baseline's tests are unchanged.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` at smoke size is green.

## Size and risks

Medium: about 150 lines plus tests, all in `crates/ai` (hard by rule 11). The risk is a weight that costs strength elsewhere, so the gate is the check; the horizon is a tuning number to revisit after #3574's sweep.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

Class: `ai` → `priority:low`; relabel to change it.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-3` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43409504034)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

The practice AI prices Burn and Toxic, which both seats can see (R3540005).
- **Units.** A unit's worth falls by the damage its coming ticks deal it, after Divine Shield and Armor (R3540001). A unit the next tick kills is worth only a small share of itself.
- **Heroes.** A hero's side loses the life its coming ticks take over a named horizon, Toxic every turn and Burn's 3-a-tick decay. The hero's armor meets Burn but not Toxic.
- **Effect.** Burn on the enemy board and Toxic on the enemy hero raise the seat's eval. The same counters on its own side lower it. The static trader (`kill_worth`) and the move order read the new worth, since both call `unit_worth`.
- **Greedy baseline.** Every new weight is 0 in `GREEDY_EVAL`, so the greedy baseline's tests are unchanged.
- **Gate.** `cargo jackioh gate` at smoke size must be green.

Rejected and recorded in the ruling: teaching `features.rs` (a refit, R3535002), and discounting `face_threat` for a doomed attacker.

## Files to touch

| File | | What |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | three `EvalWeights` fields, their `AI_EVAL` and `GREEDY_EVAL` values, `AI_AFFLICTION_TICKS`, const asserts |
| `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` | change | `afflicted_worth` (called in `unit_worth`), `hero_affliction_loss` (called in `hero_side`), imports, doc line in the header |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/evaluate.rs` | change | new `mod r3822000_burn_and_toxic` at the end |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/decide.rs` | change | new `mod r3822000_afflicted_targets` at the end |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | one paragraph in the evaluation section |
| `spec/rulings/R3822000.md` | new | the ruling note |
| `spec/pending/3822.md` | new | its §11 paragraph |

Do not touch:
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`.
- `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/tools`, `apps/`.
- `crates/ai/src/features.rs` and the learned weights.
- `spec/11-rulings.md` and `spec/INDEX.md`.
- SPEC §6 and §9.9, which are read only.
- Anything for `cargo jackioh spec index`, which must not be run.

Governing text: SPEC §4.4 (step 1 shield, step 2 armor), §6.3 (Burn, Toxic), R3540001, R3540005, CLAUDE.md rules 3, 4, 7 and 9. R3064000 and R3695000 are the precedents for an AI-pricing ruling.

## Steps

1. **`config.rs`, struct `EvalWeights`.** Add three `pub f64` fields after `awaken`, each with a `///` doc citing R3822000.
   - `unit_affliction`: per point of damage the coming ticks deal a unit that survives them, as a share of its `health` weight.
   - `unit_doomed`: a unit the nth tick kills keeps `1 − unit_doomed / n` of its worth, the form `brittle_share` uses.
   - `hero_affliction`: the share of the hero value's loss the coming ticks cost, on `hero_value`'s curve.
2. **`config.rs`, `AI_EVAL`.** After `awaken: 1.0,` set `unit_affliction: 0.5`, `unit_doomed: 0.8`, `hero_affliction: 0.5`. The comment says: untuned starts, to revisit after #3574's sweep, and gate numbers go in step 12.
3. **`config.rs`, `GREEDY_EVAL`.** After `awaken: 0.0,` set all three to `0.0`.
4. **`config.rs`, horizon.** Above `pub const AI_EVAL` add `pub const AI_AFFLICTION_TICKS: i32 = 4;` with a doc.
   - It counts the controller's next turn starts that the AI reads a counter over.
   - 4 holds Burn 10's whole series (10, 7, 4, 1), the largest printed.
   - Toxic is read for 4 turns, which a game rarely outlasts.
   - After `AI_EVAL` add `const _: () = assert!(AI_AFFLICTION_TICKS >= 1);` and an assert that `AI_EVAL.unit_doomed` lies in `0.0..=1.0`, in the style of `LEARNED_CORRECTION_SHARE`'s assert.
5. **`evaluate.rs`, imports.**
   - Add `burn_on`, `toxic_on`, `hero_burn_of`, `hero_toxic_of` to the `jackioh_engine::{…}` list.
   - Add `use jackioh_engine::config::BURN_DECAY` to the existing `jackioh_engine::config::{…}` import.
   - Add `AI_AFFLICTION_TICKS` to the `crate::config::{…}` import.
   - Run `cargo fmt`, which sorts them.
6. **`evaluate.rs`, new private fn above `unit_worth`:** `fn afflicted_worth(value: f64, unit: &CardInstance, view: &UnitView, w: &EvalWeights) -> f64`.
   - **Early returns.** Return `value` unchanged when `burn_on(unit) == 0 && toxic_on(unit) == 0`, when `w.unit_affliction == 0.0 && w.unit_doomed == 0.0`, or when `view.keywords` has `KeywordKind::Indestructible` (it takes no damage, step 4).
   - **State.** `let mut shield = has_keyword(&view.keywords, KeywordKind::DivineShield); let mut health = view.health;`.
   - **Loop.** `for tick in 1..=AI_AFFLICTION_TICKS`:
     - `burning = burn.saturating_sub((tick - 1) * BURN_DECAY)`.
     - `dealt = 0`.
     - If `burning > 0`: when `shield`, set `shield = false` (the hit is negated); otherwise `dealt = burning.saturating_sub(view.armor).max(0)`.
     - If `toxic > 0`: when `shield`, set `shield = false`; otherwise `dealt = dealt.saturating_add(toxic)` (Toxic pierces Armor).
     - `health = health.saturating_sub(dealt)`.
     - If `health <= 0`, `return value * (1.0 - w.unit_doomed / f64::from(tick));`.
   - **After the loop.** `value - w.unit_affliction * w.health * f64::from(view.health - health)`.
   - **Shield order.** Burn's hit meets the shield before Toxic's in the same tick, as `tick_at_turn_start` orders them.
   - **Doc.** The comment cites R3540001 and R3822000 and says the tick precedes start-of-turn triggers.
7. **`evaluate.rs`, `unit_worth`.** Immediately before the final `value * brittle_share(unit, w) + …` expression add, with a one-line comment citing R3822000, `value = afflicted_worth(value, unit, &view, w);`. Nothing else in `unit_worth` changes. Plague, `death` and `turn_hook` stay outside it.
8. **`evaluate.rs`, new private fn above `hero_side`:** `fn hero_affliction_loss(state: &GameState, player: PlayerId, w: &EvalWeights) -> f64`.
   - **Early returns.** Return `0.0` when `w.hero_affliction == 0.0`, when both `hero_burn_of` and `hero_toxic_of` are 0, or when `effective_life(state, player) <= 0` (`hero_value` already scores −win).
   - **Damage.** `armor = hero_armor_of(state, player)`; `damage = Σ over tick in 1..=AI_AFFLICTION_TICKS of burn.saturating_sub((tick-1)*BURN_DECAY).saturating_sub(armor).max(0).saturating_add(toxic)`, summed with `saturating_add`.
   - **Loss.** Let `life = effective_life(…)`, `start = starting_life(…)`, `after = life.saturating_sub(damage).max(1)`. Return `w.hero_affliction * (hero_value(life, start, w) - hero_value(after, start, w))`.
   - **Clamp.** The 1-life clamp keeps a lethal clock a large finite loss. A tick that really kills is already seen by the reply sim.
9. **`evaluate.rs`, `hero_side`.** Subtract `hero_affliction_loss(state, player, w)`. `hero_side(seat) − hero_side(opp)` then does the right thing for both seats.
10. **`evaluate.rs`, file header.** Add one sentence to the `//!` header: R3822000 prices Burn and Toxic on units and heroes.
11. **`README.md`.** After the paragraph ending "…`GREEDY_EVAL` keeps 0 (#2928)." and before "It re-plans after every action", add a paragraph that says:
    - Burn and Toxic count by their coming ticks (R3822000, R3540001): `afflicted_worth` takes from a unit the damage `AI_AFFLICTION_TICKS` ticks deal it, after Divine Shield and Armor, at `unit_affliction`.
    - A unit the nth tick kills keeps `1 − unit_doomed / n`.
    - `hero_side` takes `hero_affliction` of the life curve's loss over the same horizon, Burn's armor-met series and Toxic's every tick, clamped at 1 life.
    - `GREEDY_EVAL` keeps 0, and the learned features still leave both counters out until a refit.
12. **Ruling.** Create `spec/rulings/R3822000.md` and `spec/pending/3822.md`.
    - **Format.** Copy the front-matter format of `R3695000.md`. The pending file copies the format of `spec/pending/3828.md`: `**[[R3822000]] … (issue #3822, 2026-11-13)**: …`.
    - **Front matter.** `id: R3822000`; a title such as "The AI prices Burn and Toxic on Units and heroes (issue #3822)"; `cards: "§2.2, §4.4, §6.3, §9.9, R185, R2424000, R3540000, R3540001, R3540005; Stinkyscape+ (issue #3534)"`; `proven_in` lists `crates/ai/tests/ai/evaluate.rs` and `crates/ai/tests/ai/decide.rs`.
    - **Body.** Rulings are written as `[[R…]]` and sections as `[[§…]]`, and the body says no game rule changes. It has these parts:
      - What it counts, with the tick model above.
      - What is not counted: Anti-oneshot caps and a hero's other caps, `face_threat` and `threat` for a doomed attacker, a doomed unit's Death price and turn hook (still counted whole), and heals, cleanses and Vanilla.
      - The approximation: the reply sim already sees one tick a side, and this reads the ticks it does not.
      - The decide-test note from the Tests section below.
      - The gate numbers you ran, and the weights as untuned starts.
      - Rejected alternatives: a smooth doom curve; separate horizons for units and heroes; −win for a hero whose ticks reach 0; reading the counters in the learned features; discounting `face_threat`.
13. **Tests.** Write the tests in the Tests section below.
14. **Check.** Run the commands under Tests, then fill the gate numbers into the ruling.

## Tests

**`crates/ai/tests/ai/evaluate.rs`**, new `mod r3822000_burn_and_toxic { use super::*; … }`. Copy the imports of `mod r2490000_backrow_unit_priced_once` for `find_instance_mut` and add the others it needs (`active_units_of`, `EvalWeights`, `kill_worth`).

Helpers (do not define `det`, `ai_options`, `js`, `unit` or `ids`; `support.rs` has them):
- `two_vanillas()`: `board(json!({"p1":{"hand":["core-008"],"field":["core-008"]},"p2":{"hand":["core-008"],"field":["core-008"]}}))`. Mr. Vanilla is a 4/4 with no keywords, worth 8.8.
- `afflicted_unit(state, player, burn, toxic) -> GameState`: clones, finds `active_units_of(..)[0]`, and sets `counters.burn` and `counters.toxic` through `find_instance_mut`, as `Some(n)` when n > 0.
- `afflicted_hero(state, player, burn, toxic)`: sets `players[player].hero_burn` and `hero_toxic`.

Tests:
- `r3822000_burn_or_toxic_on_an_enemy_unit_raises_the_seats_eval_and_on_its_own_unit_lowers_it`: for (burn, toxic) in (2,0), (0,1), (4,0), (0,4), assert strict `>` for the enemy's unit and `<` for the AI's own, against the base eval (`eval(state, AI)`).
- `r3822000_a_unit_its_next_tick_kills_is_worth_less_than_the_same_unit_without_the_counter`:
  - Use `unit_worth` on a cloned instance with `counters.burn` or `counters.toxic` set, and `assert_close(…, 9)`.
  - Burn 4 on health 4 equals `plain * (1.0 - AI_EVAL.unit_doomed)`.
  - Toxic 2, which dies on tick 2, equals `plain * (1.0 - AI_EVAL.unit_doomed / 2.0)`.
  - Burn 2 equals `plain - AI_EVAL.unit_affliction * AI_EVAL.health * 2.0`.
  - Doomed < surviving < plain.
  - `kill_worth` of the doomed unit < `kill_worth` of the plain one.
- `r3822000_divine_shield_and_armor_meet_the_ticks_as_r3540001_says`: grant keywords on a cloned instance, with `granted_keywords.push(Keyword::DivineShield)` and `Keyword::Armor { n: 3 }`.
  - Shield with Burn 4: the shield eats the first hit and the series gives 0, 1, 0, 0, so the unit loses exactly `unit_affliction * health * 1.0`. Without the shield it is doomed.
  - Armor 3 with Burn 3: the worth is exactly unchanged.
  - Armor 3 with Burn 4: it loses exactly one point's worth.
  - Armor 3 with Toxic 1: it is doomed (4 ticks of 1 against health 4), so Armor does not help against Toxic.
- `r3822000_a_heros_burn_or_toxic_lowers_its_owners_side_and_raises_the_other`: Toxic 2 and Burn 3 on the enemy hero raise `eval(AI)`; on the AI's hero they lower it.
- `r3822000_a_heros_toxic_weighs_more_than_an_equal_burn_over_the_horizon`: for n in 2, 3, 5, `eval(enemy Toxic n) > eval(enemy Burn n)`, and `eval(own Toxic n) < eval(own Burn n)`.
- `r3822000_a_hero_loses_the_curves_share_of_the_life_its_ticks_take`:
  - Hero at 30 with Toxic 3: 12 damage over 4 ticks. `eval(base) − eval(own Toxic 3)` is `AI_EVAL.hero_affliction * (30.0 − (18.0 * 30.0).sqrt())`, `assert_close(.., 9)`. The enemy hero's side is equal and opposite.
  - Hero armor 3 with Burn 3: eval unchanged. With Toxic 3: unchanged loss.
  - Hero at 3 life with Toxic 5: the score is finite and above `-AI_EVAL.win / 2.0`, which shows the clamp.
- `r3822000_greedy_eval_and_zero_weights_read_no_counter`: assert the three `GREEDY_EVAL` fields are `0.0`. Using `EvalWeights { unit_affliction: 0.0, unit_doomed: 0.0, hero_affliction: 0.0, ..AI_EVAL }` and `GREEDY_EVAL`, an afflicted unit board and an afflicted hero board score exactly equal to their unafflicted twins.
- `r3822000_an_unafflicted_board_scores_as_before_and_the_redacted_view_reads_alike`: `eval(&redact(&afflicted, AI), AI) == eval(&afflicted, AI)` for a unit and a hero (public state, R3540005; a placeholder carries none).

**`crates/ai/tests/ai/decide.rs`**, new `mod r3822000_afflicted_targets`.
- Test `r3822000_the_ai_attacks_the_unit_its_own_burn_will_not_kill`.
- Setup: copy the style of the helpers in `even_trades.rs`. Use `scenario` with seed `"decide-burning-target"`: p1 field `[{"def":"core-053","lane":1}]` (Reno 4/6) and p2 field `[{"def":"core-008","lane":1},{"def":"core-008","lane":2}]`, an empty hand, and the `LIBRARY` consts already in the file or `["core-008","core-011","core-008","core-011"]`. Call `register_cards()` first.
- Put `counters.burn = Some(4)` on the lane-1 Vanilla via `find_instance_mut`. Its next tick deals 4, equal to its health.
- Call `must_decide(&state, AI, "decide-burning-target")` and assert the action is `ActionBody::Attack { attacker_id: reno, target_id: <the lane-2 Vanilla> }`.
- **Guard.** Write this test before step 6 and run it. The reply sim already ends the turn for real and sees the first tick that kills a unit, so it probably passes before the change. If it does, keep it as a guard and say so in the ruling. If the AI does something other than an attack for an unrelated reason, adjust the setup, such as the enemy hero's life, until it attacks.
- **Mutation check.** After the change, set the three new `AI_EVAL` weights to 0 once to confirm that the evaluate tests fail, then restore them.

**Commands**
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai r3822000`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` (whole crate once at the end; the `GREEDY_EVAL` and existing evaluate tests must pass unchanged)
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo jackioh spec check`
- `cargo jackioh gate`, at smoke size. Floors: ai-vs-random 17 of 20, ai-vs-greedy 10, hard-vs-easy 16. Record what it reads.

## Done when

- [ ] Units price coming ticks (shield and armor met) and a unit the next tick kills is worth `1 − unit_doomed` of itself.
- [ ] Heroes price Burn's series and Toxic over `AI_AFFLICTION_TICKS`, and Toxic outweighs an equal Burn.
- [ ] All new numbers are named in `config.rs`, and the three `GREEDY_EVAL` weights are 0.
- [ ] The evaluate and decide tests above pass, and no existing test changed.
- [ ] The README paragraph, `R3822000.md` and `spec/pending/3822.md` exist.
- [ ] `spec check`, fmt, clippy, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` and `cargo jackioh gate` (smoke) are green, with their numbers in the ruling.
- [ ] The ruling records the decisions made and their rejected alternatives, and says whether the decide test passed before the change.

## Risks

- **No change without counters.** Both helpers return early, so a board with no counters keeps bit-identical scores.
- **Strength.** Weights are untuned. The smoke gate is the check, and the horizon and weights are to be revisited after #3574's sweep.
- **Overflow.** Counts can be `i32::MAX` (`afflict` saturates), so use `saturating_*` as written.
- **Hidden information.** Field counters and hero counters are public. Face-down cards cannot carry them, so a `redact` placeholder loses nothing.
- **Purity.** No clock, no I/O and no hash-ordered collection are added.
- **Learned correction.** The learned correction still ignores both counters. It re-scores finalists only, so it blends the hand eval's new terms at full strength.
- **Export names.** `lib.rs` re-exports `config::*` and `evaluate::*`, so every exported name must be unique across the crate. The new fns are private.
- **Doomed unit's Death hook.** A doomed unit's Death price and turn hook are left whole (Death still fires, and the hook never does). This is an approximation that the ruling states.

## Open questions

None. A person may want to retune `unit_affliction`, `unit_doomed`, `hero_affliction` and `AI_AFFLICTION_TICKS` after #3574's sweep.
```
